items.title: 两名拟任大使被否决后，拉斯特里亚自由党内部分歧加深的五点解读
items.titleEn: Five things to understand about growing divisions in Rastriya Swatantra Party after two proposed ambassadors were rejected
items.status: DeepSeek 正文分析 · 待 Codex 核验
items.statusEn: DeepSeek article analysis · pending Codex review
items.summary: 据eKantipur报道，议会听证委员会否决了拟任驻沙特阿拉伯大使吉里巴哈杜尔·苏纳尔和拟任驻马来西亚大使楚达马尼·卡雷尔的提名，另将拟任驻日本大使吉安库马尔·塔帕的决定暂缓。报道称，苏纳尔面临女性暴力指控，卡雷尔被问及财务往来和利益冲突；委员会主席称两人未达到2075年大使任命指导方针规定的资格。报道还说，在拥有八名委员的十五人委员会作出该决定后，执政党拉斯特里亚自由党（RSP）主席拉比·拉米奇哈内与总理巴伦德拉·沙阿阵营之间的分歧浮出水面。报道同时提到政府此前开放竞争性申请、收到逾4400份申请等程序细节，但均系该媒体陈述，尚未经独立核实。
items.summaryEn: According to eKantipur, the parliamentary hearing committee rejected the proposed ambassadors to Saudi Arabia, Giribahadur Sunar, and to Malaysia, Chudamani Kharel, and held the decision on proposed ambassador to Japan Gyan Kumar Thapa. The report says Sunar faced allegations of violence against women and Kharel was questioned over financial dealings and possible conflict of interest; the committee chair said they did not meet qualifications under the 2075 ambassador appointment directive. The report adds that after the 15-member committee, where the ruling Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP) holds eight seats, made the decision, divisions surfaced between RSP chair Rabi Lamichhane and Prime Minister Balendra Shah's camp. The report also cites the government's earlier open competitive application process and over 4,400 applications; these are the outlet's claims, not independently verified.
items.analysis: 若报道所述的否决与暂缓确已完成，则直接影响是相关驻外使馆的任命时间可能被推迟，进而影响领事服务和对尼泊尔侨民的对接，但这一影响取决于后续提名程序。报道中关于党内分歧、总理与主席阵营对立的说法主要依赖匿名党员引述，缺乏可公开核验的文件。下一步应查证议会听证委员会正式会议记录、2075年大使任命指导方针文本，以及外交部是否已重新提名或撤回人选。证据缺口包括被否决议员的具体裁定理由、总理办公室是否作出回应，以及日本人选暂缓的正式依据。
items.analysisEn: If the reported rejection and hold are confirmed, the immediate effect would be possible delays in staffing the relevant missions, which could in turn affect consular services and diaspora engagement, though that depends on follow-on nomination procedures. The report's claims about internal party divisions and a rift between the prime minister's and the chair's camps rely heavily on unnamed party members and lack publicly checkable documents. The next verification step is to obtain the hearing committee's official minutes, the text of the 2075 ambassador appointment directive, and any foreign ministry notice re-nominating or withdrawing candidates. Evidence gaps include the specific grounds the committee cited, whether the prime minister's office has responded, and the formal basis for holding the Japan nominee.

items.title: 苏达卡尔·达莱拉被任命为印度驻尼泊尔大使
items.titleEn: Sudhakar Dalela appointed as India's ambassador to Nepal
items.status: DeepSeek 正文分析 · 待 Codex 核验
items.statusEn: DeepSeek article analysis · pending Codex review
items.summary: 据NepalKhabar报道，印度已任命苏达卡尔·达莱拉为驻尼泊尔新任大使，称他是印度外交部的资深外交官，此前在印度外交部担任经济关系司秘书。报道称，印度早前已就此向尼泊尔外交部发出普通照会，达莱拉将成为印度第27任驻尼泊尔大使。报道列举了他在以色列、巴西、芝加哥、达卡、日内瓦、廷布和华盛顿等地任职的经历，以及2022年至2025年任驻不丹大使、在印度外交部北方司负责尼泊尔和不丹事务等履历。报道还说，前任大使纳文·斯里瓦斯塔瓦于2026年10月1日结束任期回国。上述履历细节均来自该媒体报道。
items.summaryEn: NepalKhabar reports that India has appointed Sudhakar Dalela as its new ambassador to Nepal, describing him as a senior Indian Foreign Service diplomat who had been serving as secretary for economic relations in India's external affairs ministry. The report says India earlier sent a note verbale to Nepal's foreign ministry and that Dalela will be India's 27th ambassador to Nepal. It lists postings in Israel, Brazil, Chicago, Dhaka, Geneva, Thimphu and Washington, and notes he served as ambassador to Bhutan from 2022 to 2025 and worked on Nepal and Bhutan affairs in the ministry's northern division. It adds that predecessor Naveen Srivastava completed his term and returned to India on October 1, 2026. These biographical details come from the outlet's report.
items.analysis: 若任命得到双方确认，尼泊尔和印度之间的例行外交渠道预计将延续，达莱拉此前负责尼泊尔和不丹事务及经济关系的履历，可能影响双边经济与互联互通议题的处理方式，但这是基于履历的推断而非报道中的承诺。需注意该报道未提及任何具体电信、数字或投资协议。下一步应查证印度外交部发布的任命公告、尼泊尔外交部接受新任大使的正式程序，以及达莱拉递交国书的日程。证据缺口包括正式履新日期和双方对优先议题的公开表态。
items.analysisEn: If the appointment is confirmed by both sides, routine diplomatic channels between Nepal and India would likely continue, and Dalela's prior work on Nepal and Bhutan affairs and economic relations could shape how bilateral economic and connectivity issues are handled, though that is an inference from his CV, not a stated commitment. The report contains no specific telecom, digital or investment agreement. The next verification step is to check the Indian external affairs ministry's appointment announcement, Nepal's foreign ministry's formal agrement procedure, and the schedule for presenting credentials. Evidence gaps include the confirmed date of arrival and public statements on priority issues.

items.title: 两名拟任大使被否决后政府不满，听证委员会主席遭质问
items.titleEn: Government reportedly displeased after two proposed ambassadors rejected; hearing committee chair questioned
items.status: DeepSeek 正文分析 · 待 Codex 核验
items.statusEn: DeepSeek article analysis · pending Codex review
items.summary: 据NepalKhabar报道，在议会听证委员会否决两名拟任大使后，政府方面表现出不满，总理巴伦德拉·沙阿办公室的首席顾问和首席私人秘书致电委员会主席博德纳拉扬·什雷斯塔进行质问。报道称，委员会周三就多国拟任大使举行听证，仅批准了10个国家的提名，暂缓日本人选，并否决了拟任驻沙特阿拉伯的吉里巴哈杜尔·苏纳尔和拟任驻马来西亚的楚达马尼·卡雷尔。报道引述一名委员称，电话质疑委员会为何推翻政府决定。报道还称，RSP主席拉比·拉米奇哈内曾要求委员会凭良知决定。所有这些说法均基于匿名委员引述，尚未独立核实。
items.summaryEn: NepalKhabar reports that the government appeared displeased after the parliamentary hearing committee rejected two proposed ambassadors, with the chief adviser and chief personal secretary in Prime Minister Balendra Shah's office calling committee chair Bodhnarayan Shrestha to question the decision. The report says the committee held hearings Wednesday on proposed ambassadors to several countries, approved only 10 countries' nominees, held the Japan nominee, and rejected proposed ambassadors to Saudi Arabia, Giribahadur Sunar, and to Malaysia, Chudamani Kharel. It quotes a committee member saying the call questioned why the committee overturned the government's decision. It also says RSP chair Rabi Lamichhane had told the committee to decide according to its conscience. All these claims rest on unnamed committee members and are not independently verified.
items.analysis: 若报道所述电话施压属实，则涉及行政部门与立法监督机构之间的边界问题，可能影响今后大使任命的程序公信力，并使相关驻外使馆的任命进一步延后。但报道核心事实依赖匿名委员的引述，总理办公室方面未见公开回应，通话内容无法独立核验。下一步应查证听证委员会的正式决定文本和会议记录、委员会主席的公开表态，以及总理办公室是否发布声明。证据缺口包括通话记录、被否决提名的正式理由，以及是否启动重新提名程序。
items.analysisEn: If the reported phone pressure is accurate, it raises a question about the boundary between the executive and a legislative oversight body, which could affect the procedural credibility of future ambassador appointments and further delay staffing of the relevant missions. However, the core facts rest on unnamed committee members, no public response from the prime minister's office is cited, and the call contents cannot be independently verified. The next verification step is to check the committee's formal decision text and minutes, any public statement by the committee chair, and whether the prime minister's office has issued a statement. Evidence gaps include call records, the formal grounds for rejecting the nominees, and whether re-nomination has begun.
